info.name: FRED Maps API (GeoFRED) Categories Observations API
FRED Get the Observations or Data Values for an Economic Data Series

params.name: file_type
params.description: Response format. xml (default) or json. The observations endpoint additionally accepts xlsx and csv.

params.name: realtime_start
params.description: Start of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: realtime_end
params.description: End of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of observations to return (1–100000).

params.name: offset
params.description: Non-negative integer offset into the result set for pagination.

params.name: units
params.description: Unit transformation applied to the data.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency to aggregate the series to.

params.name: aggregation_method
params.description: How to aggregate when a frequency is supplied.

params.name: output_type
params.description: Observations output type. 1=observations by real-time period

params.name: vintage_dates
params.description: Comma-separated list of YYYY-MM-DD vintage dates.

items.docs: Get the observations or data values for an economic data series. Supports frequency aggregation and unit transformations.
